subject: Renewal options and invoice cadence for AstraThera
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Nadia Khan <nadia.k@astrathera.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal options and invoice cadence for AstraThera

Hi Nadia —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Per our call I put together two practical paths so procurement can evaluate quickly; attached is a short one-pager that outlines numbers and invoice cadence (renewal_options_v1.pdf). High level: 

1) Annualized uplift (single-year renewal, co-term to 12/31/2027)
   - 20% seat/usage uplift vs current run rate, billed upfront in one invoice for Q4 2026.
   - We can include a 8% prepay credit if AstraThera signs by 9/30.

2) Staged growth + true-up (preferred if cashflow timing is a concern)
   - Commit to incremental 20% uplift over six months; billed monthly with a single true-up invoice at year-end.
   - 12% one-time implementation credit applied at first invoice.

If procurement needs a single invoice to align to FY, option 1 is easiest. If they prefer smoothing, option 2 keeps ops flexible. Ben and Lauren are looped for approvals and any SLA/credit carveouts.

Next steps: let me know which path procurement prefers and whether a PO is required before DocuSign.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive — Renewals & Expansion
Redwood Inference
attach: renewal_options_v1.pdf
From: Nadia Khan <nadia.k@astrathera.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: purchasing@astrathera.com
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal options and invoice cadence for AstraThera

Mina —

Appreciate the clear options. A few procurement constraints on our side:

- AstraThera needs co-term to our fiscal year end (12/31/2027).
- We prefer a single annual invoice for budget reasons but can accept staged billing if we receive a 10% discount on list for the staged approach.
- PO is required before signature; our purchasing team will issue once terms are agreed (I copied them).

If you can come back with a final number that gives us a pathway to staged billing with a firm 10% discount, I can route to purchasing quickly.

Thanks,
Nadia Khan
Head of Platform Partnerships
AstraThera
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Nadia Khan <nadia.k@astrathera.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal options and invoice cadence for AstraThera

Nadia —

Thanks for the clarity. Two quick thoughts from our side:

1) We can prioritize staged billing while preserving a predictable economics outcome for Redwood. We would:
   - Offer a 12% one-time implementation credit applied at first invoice (illustrated in attached redwood_uplift_slate.docx).
   - Guarantee capacity and priority support for the staged period.

2) Alternatively, if AstraThera signs for the single annual invoice (option 1), we can extend an 8% prepay credit and a modest SLA credit buffer.

I realize you asked for a 10% discount for staged billing. Given approval windows on our end, I can offer the staged path with the 12% implementation credit + an expedited onboarding credit, but the straight 10% off list on recurring charges is tougher. If procurement needs a numeric that looks like a discount, we can convert part of the implementation credit to a billable discount on the first invoice to mirror the 10% feel.

Mina — please confirm if legal needs to review the SLA carveout before we send to Nadia. I attached the slide with the math.

Cheers,
Ben
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
attach: redwood_uplift_slate.docx
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal options and invoice cadence for AstraThera

Ben / Mina —

Quick internal: I'm comfortable approving the staged-billing path if we convert the 12% implementation credit to an 8% upfront credit plus a 4% usage discount applied to the first two invoices (this preserves our $ impact while satisfying procurement's desire for a visible discount). We should also include a 30-day SLA carveout for the onboarding window.

Mina — if AstraThera confirms PO-first, we can fast-track legal review and sign off on the modified credit structure. Please confirm customer priority and whether they need any additional compliance artifacts.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Renewals (EMEA & US) — Redwood Inference
From: Nadia Khan <nadia.k@astrathera.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 15:40:00 -0700

Mina —

Thanks — AstraThera will accept the staged-billing path with the converted credit structure as Lauren described: 8% upfront credit plus a 4% discount on the first two invoices, co-term to 12/31/2027, and the 30-day onboarding SLA carveout. Procurement will issue PO_43321 and has requested the DocuSign link after the PO is in place. I attached the PO stub for your billing team.

Forwarding the PO to you and copied purchasing.
